railway_context: Urban North-South railway corridor through Giai Phong/Giap Bat, Hanoi.
scientific_role: Dense urban canyon and high-rise residential/commercial blocks near track; useful for evaluating blockage, rich multipath, street-grid scattering, and trackside gNB placement in a Vietnamese metropolitan corridor.

railway_context: Rail bridge and urban river-crossing corridor over the Red River at Long Bien/Gia Lam, Hanoi.
scientific_role: Large river surface, steel bridge structure, open water reflection and dense urban banks; useful for bridge/river multipath and transitions between urban obstruction and open propagation.

railway_context: Hanoi-Haiphong railway through Hai Duong/Phu Thai fringe.
scientific_role: Flat Red River delta corridor with railway yards, roads, water channels and sparse/medium buildings; useful as a lower-scatter baseline for delta and industrial/suburban railway environments.

railway_context: Urban port-side railway approach around Hai Phong and Thuong Ly.
scientific_role: Port city environment with industrial buildings, freight infrastructure, dense roads and water/harbor adjacency; useful for industrial clutter and maritime edge propagation.

railway_context: North-South railway near Lang Co lagoon and the northern Hai Van approach.
scientific_role: Coastal lagoon/open-water adjacency with sparse settlement and rail constrained between water and hills; useful for strong water reflections and low-clutter coastal railway channels.

Mountain-pass/coastal transition with rail curvature, tunnels/bridges where mapped, forest and sparse built environment; useful for obstruction-dominated and coastal mountain propagation. DEM should be added before final ray tracing because OSM alone is not a terrain elevation source.
